text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Kikuka Sho, the<n>race said to
determine the strongest<n>Umamusume, and Symboli
Rudolf is<n>the picture of composure.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This is one crown she will not give up.<n>We step
forward, our sights set<n>higher than ever.
